welcome.body:
Welcome to Myne, your private space to think and write.

Everything you save here is encrypted and stays on your device. Your **password** and **recovery phrase** are the only keys to it, so keep them somewhere safe. If both are ever lost, no one can get your notes back, not even us.

This is just a regular note, so make it your own. Edit it, rename it, or delete it whenever you like, and add new notes as your ideas grow.

We're glad you're here. To learn more about Myne, visit https://myne.md

briefing.heading: Before you create your vault
briefing.intro: Myne encrypts your notes so that only you can open them. Three things follow from that — read them, then continue.

no-email.ackLabel: I understand there is no email recovery.
no-email.statement: There is no email recovery. There never will be.
no-email.why: We never ask for your email, so there's no reset link and no account for support to unlock. This isn't a missing feature — it's the guarantee. Email recovery would mean we could read your notes, and Myne is built so we can't.

no-store.ackLabel: I understand Myne can't recover my password.
no-store.statement: Your password unlocks your vault. We don't store it.
no-store.why: Your password is the input to the key that decrypts your notes. It never leaves this device, and nothing on our servers can reproduce it. That's what keeps your notes private — and why we can't reset it for you.

phrase-backup.ackLabel: I understand my recovery phrase is the only backup.
phrase-backup.statement: Your recovery phrase is your only backup.
phrase-backup.why: If you forget your password, the 24-word recovery phrase is the one way back in. {{lostBothSecrets}} Write the phrase down and keep it somewhere safe.
